headline: A 2022 federal law renames the Akeley, Minnesota post office after Neal Kenneth Todd.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 10 Broadway Street West in Akeley, Minnesota, the Neal Kenneth Todd Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the naming applies from that date.
